🔴🔵 MATCHDAY! IT’S GOOD TO BE HOME! ❤️🐎

Today we remember Jack Evans with a minute’s silence and raise awareness of men’s mental health. ❤️

We welcome league leaders Sandbach United. Kick-off 2pm at the Theatre of Jockeys!

CMON DAWLEY ❤️

Dawley Town v Sandbach United

@DawleyTownFC 

Finishes here Dawley 3 Sandbach 1 and it’s another disappointing away performance where we are undone by two soft goals given away either side of HT. A spirited last 20 mins but not enough to get anything from the game…

FULLTIME! We claim all 3 points in a huge 3-1 win at home to top of the league Sandbach! 

That was for you Jack! ❤️
